purpose: Locate an intervening event at a particular moment.
keywords: V dictionary / Vている / Vた + ところに
Just as I was about to go out, a call came.
While I was struggling alone, a friend came to help.
Just after we finished tidying up, another delivery arrived.
formation: V dictionary / Vている / Vた + ところに
restrictions: An external event arrives at the stage described by ところ.
mistake: The preceding aspect shows whether the action is about to start, ongoing, or finished.
